title: DNA extraction and qPCR for Trypanosoma cruzi
author: Brooke E. White
materials: Discard the filtrate and retain the collection tube.
Discard filtrate and reuse the collection tube.
Let sit at room temperature for 3-5 minutes.

steps.title: Collect and centrifuge blood
steps.instruction: Take 3–10 mL freshly collected blood in K₂‑EDTA (purple‑top) tubes, keep on ice, and centrifuge at 2000 g for 15 min to separate plasma from cells. If blood was previously separated and frozen, thaw completely before starting extraction.

steps.title: Store plasma
steps.instruction: Transfer the plasma layer to pre‑labelled storage tube(s) and store at –80 °C until needed.

steps.title: Prepare cell pellet suspension
steps.instruction: Transfer the cell pellet from the blood tube into a nuclease‑free 50 mL conical tube and bring the volume to 10 mL with PBS. (Plasma, whole blood or the pellet may be used, but the pellet gives highest sensitivity.)

steps.title: Add Proteinase K and vortex
steps.instruction: Add 250 µL Proteinase K solution (kit‑included) to the tube, close tightly, and vortex thoroughly.

steps.title: Add BL Buffer and RNase A
steps.instruction: Add 10.2 mL BL Buffer (kit‑included) and 20 µL RNase A (kit‑included) to the mixture, then vortex thoroughly.

steps.title: Incubate lysate at 70 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube at 70 °C in a Shake‑N‑Bake incubator for 30 min, vortexing once at the 15‑min mark; set the shaker platform to medium rocking speed.

steps.title: Load lysate onto spin column
steps.instruction: Insert a kit column into a 50 mL collection tube (both provided).

steps.title: Ethanol precipitation and binding
steps.instruction: Add 10.3 mL 100 % ethanol to the lysed mixture, vortex, then transfer the mixture (including precipitates) onto the column and centrifuge at 4 000 rcf for 5 min. Repeat the ethanol addition, transfer, and centrifugation until the entire sample (~15 mL per transfer) has passed through the column.

substeps.instruction: Transfer to column, centrifuge 4 000 rcf 5 min.

steps.title: Wash column with HBC Buffer
steps.instruction: Add 5 mL HBC Buffer (kit‑included; dilute with isopropanol before use) to the column and centrifuge at 4 000 rcf for 3 min.

steps.title: Wash column with DNA Wash Buffer
steps.instruction: Add 15 mL DNA Wash Buffer (kit‑included; dilute with ethanol before use) to the column, centrifuge 4 000 rcf for 5 min; repeat a second wash with another 15 mL DNA Wash Buffer and centrifuge again for 5 min.

substeps.instruction: First wash: 15 mL buffer, centrifuge 5 min.
Second wash: 15 mL buffer, centrifuge 5 min.

steps.title: Dry column
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the empty column at 4 000 rcf for 10 min to remove residual ethanol, then transfer the column into a new nuclease‑free 50 mL conical tube and dry at 70 °C for 10 min in the Shake‑N‑Bake incubator.

steps.title: Elute DNA (first elution)
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL HOT (70 °C) Elution Buffer (kit‑included) directly onto the filter inside the column and centrifuge at 4 000 rcf for 5 min.

steps.title: Clean centrifuge interior
steps.instruction: Wipe the inside of the centrifuge with bleach followed by water; wash buckets and inserts thoroughly to prevent corrosion and contamination.

steps.title: Elute DNA (second elution)
steps.instruction: Transfer the eluate back onto the filter, add 150 µL fresh Elution Buffer, and centrifuge at 4 000 rcf for 5 min.

steps.title: Collect and quantify DNA
steps.instruction: Transfer the final eluate into a nuclease‑free 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube, measure DNA concentration, and store at –20 °C (or at 4 °C if PCR will be performed shortly).

steps.title: Dilute DNA to 200 ng/µL
steps.instruction: After fragmentation, dilute the DNA to 200 ng/µL in ultrapure water, preferably in a 96‑well plate to facilitate transfer to the qPCR plate.

steps.title: Prepare qPCR master mix
steps.instruction: For a 96‑well plate (106 reactions) combine the following per 20 µL reaction: 10 µL iTaq universal probe mix, 1.5 µL Cruzi 1 primer (10 µM), 1.5 µL Cruzi 2 primer (10 µM), 0.2 µL IAC primer FW (10 µM), 0.2 µL IAC primer Rev (10 µM), 0.1 µL Cruzi 3 probe, 0.1 µL IAC probe, 0.4 µL water. Scale to the plate: iTaq 1060 µL, Cruzi 1 primer 159 µL, Cruzi 2 primer 159 µL, IAC FW 21.2 µL, IAC Rev 21.2 µL, Cruzi 3 probe 10.6 µL, IAC probe 10.6 µL, water 42.4 µL.

steps.title: Aliquot master mix and sample
steps.instruction: Add to each well 14 µL master mix, 1 µL IAC (25 pg/µL), and 5 µL diluted sample DNA.

steps.title: Run qPCR cycling program
steps.instruction: Program the cycler: 95 °C 3 min initial denaturation; then 50 cycles of 95 °C 15 sec followed by 58 °C 1 min. Select “all channels” before starting.

steps.title: Export and analyze data
steps.instruction: Export the program file at the end of the run and analyze the results using CFX Manager software.

steps.title: Wrap tubes and place on ice
steps.instruction: Wrap the 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tubes containing extracted DNA in parafilm, place them in a floating foam rack, and keep the rack in a chilled cup‑horn on ice.

steps.title: Sonicate DNA samples
steps.instruction: Set the sonifier to continuous mode, 50‑second interval, 60 % amplitude; run 5 cycles of 50 seconds each, then return samples to ice.

steps.title: Add controls and spin down
steps.instruction: Include no‑template controls (NTC) and a known‑positive T. cruzi DNA sample in each plate (e.g., 16 NTCs per 384‑well plate); briefly spin plates before starting the cycler program.
